# servicenow-mcp-ai

> A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets an MCP client (VS Code, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and others) work with a ServiceNow instance over its REST APIs. It covers Table, Aggregate, Attachment, Import Set, Batch, CMDB/IRE, Service Catalog, Change, Knowledge, Email, Flows, Codecheck and ATF. On top of those it adds script intelligence, artefact explainers and documentation generators, multi-instance profiles, plan-and-apply write safety with a local journal, and a two-axis policy model. It is an independent community project and is not affiliated with ServiceNow, Inc.

Install it with `npx -y servicenow-mcp-ai`. Run `npx servicenow-mcp-ai init` for a guided setup and `npx servicenow-mcp-ai doctor` for diagnostics. Tools come in packages that you select with `SN_TOOL_PACKAGES`. Writes are governed by `SN_WRITE_MODE` and the policy settings. Every environment setting is documented in the README's "Environment variables" section, which is generated from the settings manifest.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai#readme): install, client setup, the tool reference per package, and the environment variable reference
- [.env.example](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/blob/main/.env.example): every setting with its default, grouped by section
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/blob/main/SECURITY.md): the credential handling, policy and write-safety model
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [Architecture](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/blob/main/project/ARCHITECTURE.md): the layers, ports and adapters, and the request pipeline

## Distribution

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/servicenow-mcp-ai): `servicenow-mcp-ai`
- [MCP registry entry](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/blob/main/server.json): `io.github.IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai`
- [Landing page](https://ivanbbaev.github.io/servicenow-mcp-ai/)
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/tree/main/.claude-plugin): `/plugin marketplace add IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai`, then `/plugin install servicenow-mcp-ai`; the server wired up plus skills, subagents and hooks
- [VS Code extension](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/tree/main/extension): `ivanbbaev.servicenow-mcp-ai`; registers the server in Copilot Chat with no `mcp.json`
- [MCP bundle (.mcpb)](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/tree/main/mcpb): one-click Claude Desktop install; built with `npm run mcpb:pack`
- [Skills](https://github.com/IvanBBaev/servicenow-mcp-ai/tree/main/skills): six workflow skills (`sn-discover`, `sn-drift`, `sn-impact`, `sn-safe-write`, `sn-triage`, `sn-uib`), usable from Claude Code, Copilot, Codex and Cursor
